hints: Look closely at the DNA diagram, not just the letters. Count the hydrogen bonds (2 dashes vs 3 dashes) and look at base size (one ring vs two rings) to work out each base pair on the boxed template strand, and find which end is the 5' end.
Remember mRNA is made 5' to 3' using the template read 3' to 5', with A pairing U, T pairing A, C pairing G and G pairing C. Then read that mRNA codon from the centre outwards on the wheel.
walkthrough:
**Find the 5' end of the template and read the DNA bases**

Look at the boxed template strand on the left. The free phosphate at the bottom marks the 5' end, so we read from bottom to top in the 5' to 3' direction.

Now use shape and H-bonds. A double ring is a purine (A or G), a single ring is a pyrimidine (T or C). Two H-bonds means A-T, three H-bonds means G-C.

**Work out the template sequence 5' to 3'**

Bottom pair has 3 H-bonds with a single ring on the template, so template base is C. Middle pair also has 3 H-bonds with a single ring on the template, so template base is C. Top pair has 2 H-bonds with a double ring on the template, so template base is A.

Template read 5' to 3' (bottom to top):
$$5' \text{- C - C - A -} 3'$$

**Build the mRNA codon**

Transcription copies the template in the opposite direction. The template is read 3' to 5' (top to bottom: A-C-C) to make mRNA 5' to 3'.

Pairing rules for mRNA: A-U, T-A, C-G, G-C:
$$\text{template } 3' \text{- A - C - C -} 5' \rightarrow \text{mRNA } 5' \text{- U - G - G -} 3'$$

**Use the codon wheel**

Start in the centre with position 1: U, move to middle with position 2: G, move to edge with position 3: G. Follow U-G-G outwards and the outside label is Trp. That is the only codon for tryptophan.

options.A: Gly codons are GGU, GGC, GGA, GGG. You get GGU if you read the template in the wrong direction, top to bottom as 5' to 3', instead of bottom to top.
options.B: Pro codons are CCU, CCC, CCA, CCG. You get CCA if you mistake the coding strand or the template 5' to 3' sequence for mRNA directly without taking the complement.
options.C: Correct. Template 5'-CCA-3' means template 3'-ACC-5' makes mRNA 5'-UGG-3', and the wheel shows UGG codes for Trp.
options.D: Thr codons are ACU, ACC, ACA, ACG. This does not match UGG on the wheel and comes from mixing up the wheel positions or the DNA to mRNA conversion.
